step1_analysis.circuit_type: Differential Delay Cell with Cross-Coupled Tail Injection
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a differential delay cell used in a ring oscillator. It features cross-coupled PMOS transistors injecting current into the tail nodes of the NMOS differential pairs, which allows for continuous adjustment of delay mismatches to ensure precise I/Q phase matching.

paper_reference.title: A 1.8-GHz Self-Calibrated Phase-Locked Loop with Precise I/Q Matching

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the delay cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rload. With W/L=10, Id~100uA, gm is approx 1mS. Assuming a 5kOhm load, Gain = 5 V/V = 14 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the load impedance which is external to this subcircuit. A 5k resistor yields ~14 dB.

operating_frequency.description: The target oscillation frequency of the VCO.

sky130_expected.calculation: AC analysis to verify gain > 0dB at 1.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 is faster than 0.35um, so it will easily support 1.9 GHz operation with sufficient bandwidth.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumed by the delay cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail NMOS (W/L=10, Vgs=0.9V) sinks ~300uA. Two tails = 600uA. Power = 1.8V * 600uA = 1.08 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for a single sub-block in SKY130 at 1.8V supply.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from input to output.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 1.8 GHz ring oscillator (e.g., 4 stages), delay per stage is 1 / (2 * 4 * 1.8G) = 34.7 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the target oscillation frequency.
Phase noise is a system-level metric, but the delay cell's thermal and flicker noise contribute to it.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain/phase at 1.9 GHz, and transient propagation delay of the delay cell. Load resistors are added since the outputs are open-drain/floating in the extracted subcircuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Delay Cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N5 N4 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 LABEL_NET_4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 LABEL_NET_5 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 LABEL_NET_6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N6 LABEL_NET_7 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* External Loads (Required for open-drain outputs)
R1 N5 VDD 5k
R2 N1 VDD 5k
R3 N2 VDD 5k
R4 N6 VDD 5k

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 0.9

* Input Signal (DC bias + AC + Transient Sine)
VN4 N4 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.2 1.9G)

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(N5) v(N0)

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1M 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N5)
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(N5))
  
  meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=1M
  meas ac gain_1_9G find gain_db at=1.9G
  meas ac phase_1_9G find phase_deg at=1.9G
  
  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran v_max max v(N5)
  meas tran v_min min v(N5)
  
  * Measure propagation delay (inverting logic)
  meas tran t_in trig v(N4) val=0.9 rise=3
  meas tran t_out trig v(N5) val=1.2 fall=3
  let prop_delay = t_out - t_in
  print prop_delay
.endc
.end
